summary: Complete breakdown of 15+ high-retention YouTube niches in the horror, caught-on-camera, real-life incidents, and mystery space. Organized into 3 tiers by retention rate (60-75%, 50-65%, 45-55%), with RPM ranges, monetization risk levels, recommended top 5 niches to start with, and the exact content structure formula for achieving 60%+ audience retention. Covers: paranormal/ghost, animal attacks, true crime, seconds before disaster, security camera footage, dashcam, UFO/unexplained, 'if you see this run', Google Earth, countdown lists, natural disasters, instant karma, abandoned places, dangerous animals, and dark history/disturbing facts.
